tools.name: ipdata_lookup_ip
tools.description: Geolocation and network data for one IP address: city, region, country, continent, coordinates, postal code, time zone, currency, languages, mobile carrier, ASN, plus company and threat data where the key's plan includes them. tools.name: ipdata_get_threat
tools.description: Threat profile of one IP address: is_tor, is_proxy, is_anonymous, is_datacenter, is_known_attacker, is_known_abuser, is_threat, is_bogon, is_icloud_relay and the blocklists it appears on. Business and Enterprise plans also get is_vpn and reputation scores (vpn, proxy, threat and trust, 0-100). GET /

tools.name: ipdata_get_asn_for_ip
tools.description: The autonomous system that announces one IP address: AS number, organisation name, domain, network route and usage type (hosting, isp, edu, gov, mil, business). GET /{ip}/asn. Uses 1 request of the key's daily ipdata quota and is never retried.

tools.name: ipdata_get_company
tools.description: The end-user organisation that a network is assigned to: name, domain, network prefix and usage type. Needs the ipdata Startup plan or higher. GET /{ip}/company. Uses 1 request of the key's daily ipdata quota and is never retried.

tools.name: ipdata_lookup_asn
tools.description: Details of one autonomous system: organisation, domain, usage type, IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes, number of IPs, registry, country, allocation date, status, and upstream, downstream and peer AS numbers. GET /AS{number}. Uses 1 request of the key's daily ipdata quota and is never retried.

tools.name: ipdata_bulk_lookup
tools.description: Look up up to 100 IP addresses in one call (paid ipdata plans only). Duplicates are removed first. Replies are a list in the same order, one entry per address. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ipdata_bulk_lookup · Public sink: ipdata_bulk_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ipdata_bulk_lookup · Public sink: ipdata_bulk_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
